page_title: BET 2-0 OSA | Betis v Osasuna 28/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' A pass by Sergi Altimira (Betis) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
90+3' Abel Bretones (Osasuna) sends a cross into the box, but Pau Lopez comes off his line to gather the ball.
90+1' Osasuna failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
89' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
86' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
85' A short through ball almost allows Cucho Hernandez (Betis) to get in a good shooting position, but he loses it to one of the defenders.
83' Alessio Lisci has decided to substitute Valentin Rosier and he is replaced by Kike Barja (Osasuna).
83' Substitution. Jon Moncayola will be replaced by Asier Osambela (Osasuna).
82' Antony (Betis) sends a chip pass into the box, but Sergio Herrera is quickest to intercept the ball.
81' The attendance for today's match is 50034.
79' Antony (Betis) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
77' Hector Bellerin comes off the pitch to be replaced by Angel Ortiz (Betis).
76' Manuel Pellegrini is forced to make a change. Pablo Fornals is unable to continue due to injury, Rodrigo Riquelme (Betis) comes on.
76' The game is interrupted now, Pablo Fornals (Betis) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
74' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) connects with a pass inside the box, but his effort goes well wide of the left post.
71' The ball is cleared after Victor Munoz (Osasuna) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play. Osasuna will take a throw-in.
70' Osasuna are awarded a free kick from long range.
68' Manuel Pellegrini decides to make a substitution. Marc Roca will be replaced by Sergi Altimira (Betis).
67' Abel Bretones (Osasuna) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
66' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Iker Munoz (Osasuna) comes onto the pitch so that Moi Gomez can be given a rest.
64' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Betis.
63' Moi Gomez (Osasuna) is booked.
62' Pablo Fornals (Betis) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
60' Betis work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
59' Pablo Fornals (Betis) has a crack at goal from inside the box, but the defender somehow makes the block to deny him.
59' Moi Gomez (Osasuna) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
56' Antony (Betis) fails to score from the rebound as the goalkeeper stops his effort from hitting the net.
56' We are about to witness a subsitution. Aitor Ruibal (Betis) for Abde Ezzalzouli.
54' A player from Osasuna brings down an opponent and commits a foul. A free kick to Betis.
52' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) nutmegs the defender on the edge of the box and lashes in a shot at goal that flies high over the bar.
49' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) releases a decent shot towards the middle of the goal from the edge of the box, but it's comfortably gathered by Pau Lopez.
49' The cross into the penalty area from Marc Roca (Betis) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
48' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) leaps highest to meet the resulting corner and attempts to head home, but the effort goes harmlessly wide of the left post.
48' The referee signals a corner kick to Osasuna.
48' The corner is swung in but Osasuna can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. The ball is out of play. Osasuna will have a chance to score from a corner.
47' Good chance! Ante Budimir (Osasuna) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored!
46' Alessio Lisci prepares a substitution. Jorge Herrando is replaced by Victor Munoz (Osasuna).
46' Alessio Lisci has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Sheraldo Becker comes on the pitch for Lucas Torro (Osasuna).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) blows a huge opportunity! He latches on to a perfect cross from the wing into the penalty area, but sends a bullet header just wide of the left post!

43' Antony (Betis) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Victor Garcia with no other option than to blow for a foul. That's a free kick to Osasuna.
42' The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Osasuna.
38' 2 - 0 Cucho Hernandez (Betis) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and drills a shot into the bottom left corner in trademark fashion.
37' Betis are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
35' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
34' Betis can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

33' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the bottom left corner, but Sergio Herrera is well positioned to make a comfortable save. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Betis.
32' Pablo Fornals (Betis) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
31' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.

29' That didn't go as planned! Cucho Hernandez (Betis) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Sergio Herrera, who easily kept it out.
28' Antony (Betis) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
25' Antony (Betis) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
24' One of the Osasuna players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul. Betis will take a free kick.
23' A lofted cross from Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
22' Hector Bellerin (Betis) plays a through ball which would have led to a great opportunity, if it hadn't been stopped by the defence.
19' 1 - 0 Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) received a delightful pass inside the box before slotting the ball past the goalkeeper. What a brilliant finish!
17' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Antony (Betis) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
16' The resulting set piece from Osasuna is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
15' Antony (Betis) tries his luck with a long-range shot from a rebound, but it isn't precise at all and the ball flies well wide of the left post towards the corner flag. Very poor shot.
12' Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Victor Garcia blows his whistle for a foul. Betis have been awarded a free kick.
11' Antony (Betis) moves forward and unleashes a thunderous shot from distance that flies well over the bar.
11' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Betis comes to nothing.
9' Betis have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

9' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) announces himself with a close-range shot after a cross, but one of the defenders gets in the way of the ball to thwart him. The referee points to the corner flag and Betis will take a corner.
7' Osasuna take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
6' Pau Lopez displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Raul Garcia (Osasuna) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
3' Natan (Betis) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Osasuna will have the kick-off.
Victor Garcia will supervise the game today.
